headline: Russia launches massive overnight drone and missile barrage against Ukraine
subheadline: The attack involved 136 drones and 8 ballistic missiles targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, and Odesa, with Ukrainian defenses downing 104 UAVs and 5 missiles.
lede: Israel sealed the home of a Palestinian accused of killing two IDF officers in Tell and announced plans to demolish it, while arresting over 130 suspects in West Bank operations against Hamas and settler violence. Hamas commander Maam Awad was killed in a Gaza strike, Iran warned any attack on its territory would incur high costs, and Yemen’s Houthi forces attacked three Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea. Meanwhile, Russia launched a massive overnight campaign of 136 drones and 8 ballistic missiles at Ukraine, striking Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro and Odesa, causing fires and civilian damage, and Romanian authorities reported three drone incursions.

sections.title: Russia's Overnight Drone Assault Escalates Across Ukraine
sections.body: Russia unleashed 136 drones and eight ballistic missiles overnight, targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro and Odesa and prompting Ukrainian air defenses to intercept 104 UAVs and five missiles. The barrage ignited fires in residential areas of the four cities, killed two people and injured five in Rostov-on-Don, and wounded twelve civilians, including two children, in Belgorod region. Romania reported three Russian drone incursions over three days and prepared a diplomatic protest, while Ukrainian sources claimed a strike on a Russian military train in occupied Crimea sparked railcar fires.

sections.title: Israel Expands Operations in Gaza and West Bank
sections.body: Israeli forces sealed the home of a Palestinian accused of killing two IDF officers in Tell and announced plans to demolish it, while arresting more than 130 suspects during West Bank operations against Hamas and violent settlers. In Gaza, a strike killed Hamas commander Maam Awad, disrupting weapons production, and Iran's national security advisor warned any attack on Iran would carry high costs. Yemen's Houthi movement attacked three Saudi oil tankers in the Red Sea, and the United States expanded ammunition stockpiles at Israeli bases, including 27 munitions prepositioned at Ben-Gurion.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous intensification of Israeli operations in Gaza and the West Bank, coupled with Iran's explicit threat of high-cost retaliation, signals a coordinated escalation involving state and proxy actors. Russia's large-scale drone and missile barrage, coupled with cross-border incursions into NATO-adjacent Romania, demonstrates a widening of the Ukraine conflict's geographic and intensity thresholds.
